page.overview:
Who is Oswald?

is the protagonist of Into the Pit, the first story from Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit, and its adaptations: the video game Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit, and the interactive novel Return to the Pit. He's a young boy who, after many boring days in his dying town, decides to enter a strange ball pit that seemingly lets him travel in time, only to find himself fighting to save his father from an aggressive and mysterious Yellow Rabbit.

In the video game adaptation, along with the scrapped artwork for the original story, Oswald has spiky brown hair that is slicked back, light peach skin, and brown eyes (although they are blue on his sprite). He wears deep blue jeans with black shoes, a red and yellow striped t-shirt, and a deep blue opened up hoodie. Descriptions from Oswald's inventory items mention that he has his father's eyes.

The book's description of Oswald is very small; he has freckles and a cowlick. He wears a chain around his neck with his house key on it. In the graphic novel, he has short dark brown hair and usually wears a t-shirt and shorts.

Oswald is somewhat pessimistic due to the closure of a mill which left many without a job. He's also embarrassed by his family and electronics, hiding his outdated technology from others in his class and arguing with his father over his out-of-date tastes. Despite his desire to do more, Oswald is very understanding of his family's and others' financial situation and tries his best to be respectful. He deeply loves his parents despite their differences, and has the same sense of humor as his father.
